title: unsorted reviewed on change only

setup.note: One unsorted episode that landed BEFORE the last weekly review, and an active space its terms match. The cadence says the review is due; the change watermark says nothing landed since. A lookup answers before a call is made.

input_events: The weekly review fires with nothing written into unsorted since the last one.
Then one new episode lands in unsorted and the review fires again.

wrong.label: clock-driven-call
wrong.assert_absent: a review call made on an unsorted pile with nothing written since the last review

wrong.label: every-row-every-space
wrong.assert_absent: one call per space per row instead of one bounded call per space with candidates

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.19 SPC-07 · unsorted reviewed on change only
